text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the dim early morning of a day leading up to the Arima Kinen,
I headed to the Trainer's Room to put together a training menu.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Huh!? You're here already!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There was Hishi Amazon, diligently decorating the room.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, you know... it's Christmas today, right?
So I had set up a surprise.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"In the morning, Trainer-boy comes to work and is shocked by the room!
A total Christmas makeover—pretty cool, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's fine.
I just lacked follow-through."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I never thought you'd start working this early in the morning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This Arima Kinen is going to be
a massive showdown with Narita Brian.
choice_data_list: I just wanted to do whatever I could...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...
Well, um... thanks.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'm totally fired up for the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon said with a bashful laugh.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "—Oh, almost forgot the main event. When you think Christmas, it's gotta be this, right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon opening the present,
there was something resembling a neck warmer inside.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As I tried wrapping it around my neck—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Whatcha doing, Trainy?
It's a stomach band, so it goes on your belly, not your neck, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you're a handful too, y'know.
Here, hold still.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With that said, Hishi Amazon unfolded her belly warmer and firmly pulled it down.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? A little lower maybe?
Yeah, there we go!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The size is a perfect fit.
It looks pretty good on you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
There's a pocket inside where you can put a hand warmer,
so slip one in if you get cold.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"During the race, the stands get especially chilly, right?
I can't have my partner catching a cold!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A heartfelt gift, just like Hishi Amazon.
I decided I would make great use of it from now on.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "—So, about that Christmas present..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Dammit, because they said those weird things,
now I can't stop overthinking it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you... it was those Miho kids.
They kept teasing me while I was making it!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh? A hand-knitted scarf? Wow, you're so crafty!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ah, just looking for some Christmas presents.

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?!
Could it be, you got a lover or something?!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek?! B-But giving someone a hand-knitted
scarf definitely means that kind of—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh!?
I-I-Idiot, it's not like that at all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Argh, who cares about that
stuff! Just take it already!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening the present revealed a scarf.
It appeared to be hand-knitted. The intricate pattern was very typical of her.
choice_data_list: Thank you, I'll take good care of it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wrap it around my neck right away.
It's just the right length, and it feels great against my skin.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What's this?
...It suits you better than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, I spent a truly memorable
Christmas with Hishi Amazon.
